This '''village''' was located on [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]].

==History==
It was the site of a raid made by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], during which they [[Death/Legends|killed]] the criminal [[Hal'Sted/Legends|Hal'Sted]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] found her then-master dead and was adopted by the stranded [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ky Narec/Legends|Ky Narec]] after displaying [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-powers.
